article.headline: Brogna's 28 lead Stonehill over Wagner 73-61
article.description: — Todd Brogna scored 28 points as Stonehill beat Wagner 73-61 on Thursday night.
article.story: SOUTH EASTON, Mass. -- — Todd Brogna scored 28 points as Stonehill beat Wagner 73-61 on Thursday night. Brogna added six rebounds for the Skyhawks (12-11, 4-4 Northeast Conference). Louie Semona scored 14 points and added eight rebounds. Chas Stinson shot 4 of 7 from the field and 4 of 4 from the free-throw line to finish with 12 points. Zaire Williams led the Seahawks (11-10, 3-5) in scoring, finishing with 12 points. Wagner also got 11 points from Keyontae Lewis. The teams both play Saturday. Stonehill hosts Central Connecticut State and Wagner hosts Le Moyne. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
